issues.title: Refactoring - strip out mapping
issues.body:
Now that we have a persistent (locked) branch containing the P9 mapping, we're going to strip back all of the mapping functionality.

This will include code in these areas:
- `mapPostback` in `factory.tsx`
- `postNewMapMessage` in `wargames_api`
- `PLANNING_MESSAGE`, `INTERACTION_MESSAGE`, `// series of constants used for `messageType` when sending map events` in `globals.ts`
- `Asset.ts` in `CustomTypes`

It will also include all mapping components:
- `Components/local/mapping`

From the main wargame object, we will delete these elements:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/ccff0b83-233a-4a66-a902-a360ee98d150)

* remove `assets` from `ForceData`
